name: Dumbbell Around the World
steps: Stand with a dumbbell beside each thigh, palms forward and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep both arms out and up in wide arcs until the dumbbells are overhead.
Reverse the arcs to bring the dumbbells back to your sides.
tips: Keep your ribs stacked above your hips throughout the sweep.
Move both arms through the same comfortable arc without swinging your torso.
